info.title: Fountain Coach FCIS — Standalone Go HTTP API
info.description: Canonical FCIS-owned OpenAPI 3.1 contract, peer to FCIS-STACK.md in the Fountain-Coach/.github organization root. Describes the proposed standalone Go HTTPS/OAuth/WebAuthn/MCP/Host HTTP protocol and inherited owner/machine administration shapes. All operations are target specifications, not evidence of a deployed or callable Go service; runtime availability, grants, instrument admission, and terminal FountainStore evidence must be observed separately. MIDI2 IDL, FCIS-KIT executable instruments, FountainStore format and Stripe's provider API retain independent owners. The complete system is prerequisite-free: a clean installation initializes its own Store, vault, owner and local UI; any existing-instance import is optional and governed by FCIS-SYSTEM.json.

servers.description: Fountain Coach deployed issuer example; optional adoption profile, not required for first install
Loopback-only default fresh-install issuer; WebAuthn-capable localhost secure context; never exposed remotely

get.summary: Discover issuer-enrolled Hosts and current grant status
get.description: Use to identify signed issuer-known machines and the latest enrollment/admission states. This reads the issuer's FountainStore projection; it does not contact the Host, verify reachability, enumerate installed instruments, authorize an MCP client, or execute a tool. The configured issuer execution target is not a separately enrolled machine. An admission marked verified concerns the existing narrow Host grant, not per-client callability. Select describeSelectedHost for a separate, correlated read-only Host job.

get.summary: Inspect one selected admitted Host through host.describe
get.description:
Use to obtain an actual read-only Host description from the configured execution Host or one exact issuer-admitted opaque Host target. Owner authentication, target routing and current Host grant must all succeed. The result requires matching correlation, job identity and native Host/Store readback. Do not infer fleet-wide health or the ability to call any other instrument from a successful description.
Go target removes the predecessor's legacy Basic fallback; passkey owner authentication required.

post.summary: Issue WebAuthn registration challenge after verified owner/bootstrap authority
post.description: Requires a recently authenticated owner or protected first-owner bootstrap; a public request alone cannot enroll a new owner. Fresh-install owner enrollment has an exclusive UNCLAIMED state. The one-use local setup ticket is valid only before any owner exists; no prior owner, Store or FCIS Host is required. Once CLAIMED, only authenticated owner-session plus separately required owner approval may add a credential. Ticket challenge expires, is replay fenced and is consumed in the same durable transaction as the first public owner credential. Neither endpoint permits a second owner to claim an existing service.

ownerPasskeySession.name: fcis_owner_session
ownerPasskeySession.description: Go-owned, scoped Secure HttpOnly SameSite owner session on issuer HTTPS origin. No JavaScript access or Basic fallback for privileged administration.

oauthBearer.description: Scoped OAuth resource access token; presence alone does not authorize a Host operation.

firstOwnerSetup.name: X-FCIS-First-Owner-Setup
firstOwnerSetup.description: Single-use 256-bit operator-local setup ticket used only when installation UNCLAIMED. Stored in Go vault only as SHA-256 digest, 10-minute expiry, max 5 attempts; consumed atomically on verified first owner WebAuthn attestation. Never an OAuth client credential or Host grant.

HostTargetID.description: Opaque issuer-admitted machine target UUID, never hostname, address or URL

FoundationDateSeconds.description: Default Swift JSONEncoder Date representation: seconds since 2001-01-01 UTC, not ISO 8601.

error.description: Exact non-sensitive refusal code, e.g. owner_authentication_required, origin_not_allowed, host_not_enrolled, host_observation_unverified or owner_host_inventory_unavailable

selector.description: issuer or opaque enrolled Host target ID

machine.description: Configured issuer execution label or signed machine identity, never a raw IP address

kind.description: Configured issuer execution context or independently owner-signed enrolled machine.

enrollmentState.description: Issuer machine lifecycle, not network status: not_applicable, provisioned, admitted.

authorizationState.description: Issuer's current signed grant verification: inspect_only for the configured issuer execution target, not_verified without current grant proof, verified when current machine admission checks pass. Never interpret as authorization for the OAuth client making the HTTP request.

items.description: Canonical Host capability identity obtained from the current issuer grant. This schema deliberately has no hardcoded enum; source implementation must derive values from actual signed admissions.

capabilities.description: Names of issuer-projected permitted Host operations for this machine, not necessarily installed, routable or client-authorized MCP tools. The current handler emits host.describe or [] according to current admission.

OwnerFleetHost.description:
One signed issuer fleet inventory member; neither a live Host observation nor a complete MCP tool catalog. The current native issuer emits only host.describe for a verified current grant. Future admitted capability identifiers must not be blocked by a fixed OpenAPI enumeration, but may be advertised only when backed by issuer/Host authority.
Root Go target must project actual admitted capability inventory; predecessor enum is historical and never the authorization ceiling.

observedAt.description: Issuer Store read time, ISO 8601, not a machine heartbeat.

OwnerFleetInventory.description: Owner-passkey-protected issuer snapshot of enrollment and narrow grant admission; not reachability, complete instrument registry, or operation callability.

stdout.description: Read-only Host description, <=4096 bytes (native server limit)

HostObservation.description: A bounded, correlated Host job from the dedicated host.describe operation. This operation remains specifically host.describe and is not a generic instrument execution method.

signingMessage.description: Issuer-generated message the real device must sign

fingerprint.description: Optional until machine proof is recorded; absent rather than null under default Swift JSONEncoder for nil.
Exact fingerprint of independent device proof

signature.description: Base64 signature over canonical pairing message

hostAdmission.description: Existing FCISAdmission Codable projection; authoritative typed Kit owns its shape

issuerAdmission.description: Existing FCISAdmission Codable projection; authoritative typed Kit owns its shape

OwnerOpenAPIDocument.description: Self-contained current OpenAPI 3.1 JSON; server document generated from canonical contract at build time; this schema is a descriptive projection, not independent authority.

subject.description: Opaque owner subject; not a secret

method.description: MCP method e.g. initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping or notifications/initialized

data.description: JSON-RPC-compatible JSON value; precise tool arguments are validated against current admitted instrument schemas.

callable.description: Never infer true without a current client-specific grant and channel.

sequence.description: Unsigned per-direction monotonic frame sequence; polls acknowledge previously delivered frame

frame.description: Opaque encrypted FCIS session bytes, standard base64. Required on send (1–32768 decoded bytes), absent on poll.

nonce.description: Exactly 32 nonce bytes in standard base64. SEND requires durable replay claim.

signature.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature in standard base64 over canonical fcis-https-frame/1 bytes

HostSessionFrame.description: Existing Swift FCISHTTPSFrameRequest JSON wire. Public HTTPS permits only machine-signed host role; Foundation.Data fields are standard-base64 opaque bytes. Frame acceptance never implies Go execution or a native Store terminal.

state.description: Process health only; does not indicate usable OAuth, MCP or admitted Host operation.

FirstOwnerPasskeyAttestation.description: WebAuthn registration credential returned by navigator.credentials.create, not an authentication assertion; binary fields base64url encoded; challenge and origin must match the one-use first-owner ceremony.

FirstOwnerBootstrapPolicy.description: Reference-only bootstrap state; never disclose setup ticket in a browser response

HostSessionFrameReply.description: FCISHTTPSFrameReply: bounded encrypted transport delivery, never a Host execution terminal

frame.description: Encrypted packet on state=frame; absent otherwise

x-fcis-adjacent-existing-routes.description: Historical routes migrated into canonical target path inventory. The older Swift issuer's served-route evidence remains in its source and release receipts, not in this Go target.

predecessor.authority: historical Swift owner-management contract; retained as semantic/protocol input, no longer the writable Go target authority

x-fcis-capability-discovery.description: Source-only design for Host/MIDI2 capabilities, distinct from the HTTP route list and MCP-dispatched tools. Installed/declared/admitted/callable/live-accepted states must be evidenced by current Host+grant+Store rather than inferred from OpenAPI.

authority.instrumentIdentities: MIDI2 IDL and FCIS-KIT typed instrument contracts
authority.execution: Actual Host runtime with exact target, client and operation authorization
authority.results: Correlated Host terminal result and FountainStore evidence

x-fcis-capability-discovery.currentAdmittedOperationName: historical host.describe; do not impose fixed tool ceiling

states.declared: An operation has a typed instrument contract, not proof of Host installation.
states.installed: The target Host has an executable/adapter, not proof of a current admission.
states.admitted: Current issuer/Host signed policy permits the operation for the relevant relationship; does not grant every client.
states.routable: The selected enrolled target is reachable through an admitted channel; cannot be inferred from enrollment.
states.authorizedForClient: The exact current client relationship, scope and operation grant were independently checked.
states.callable: Requires installed, admitted, routable and currently authorized for this specific client/target/release; revalidate at execution.
states.liveAccepted: The actual invocation completed with correlated terminal Host/FountainStore evidence and required independent witness.

x-fcis-capability-discovery.boundary: Never infer a new callable instrument from this document, a provisioned machine, an OAuth registration or a host.describe success. Native implementation, grants and evidence are separate.

x-fcis-predecessor.authority: historical Swift owner-management contract; retained as semantic/protocol input, no longer the writable Go target authority

x-fcis-not-a-gate: This OpenAPI promotes API source ownership without expanding the existing Go production cutover DoD. Proposed operations are not grants, MCP tool admissions, or evidence of deployment.

x-fcis-non-http-contracts.ownerBootstrap: Restricted operator-installed first owner and WebAuthn trust binding. No unauthenticated global enrollment HTTP route.
x-fcis-non-http-contracts.fountainStore: Dedicated native Go FountainStore bootstrap and atomic grant/revocation/execution receipt persistence; no made-up HTTP persistence endpoint.
x-fcis-non-http-contracts.midi2: MIDI2 IDL/MIDI-CI instrument negotiation and Host envelopes belong to their owning contract.
x-fcis-non-http-contracts.instrument: Admitted FCIS-KIT mechanical constraints and release proof are not defined by an HTTP path.
x-fcis-non-http-contracts.payment: Second-priority provider-neutral FCIS payment instrument, Stripe adapter not yet specified/admitted as core FCIS HTTP paths.
x-fcis-non-http-contracts.regulatoryMaintenance: The organization FCIS-STACK.md section 6.1 and docs/FCIS-EU-Regulatory-Maintenance.md govern ongoing EU/German legal applicability and release evidence. No regulatory HTTP route, approval API, or legal certification is created by this metadata.

x-fcis-regulatory-maintenance.scope: Source-only applicability and change-management procedure, not deployed capability, automatically operating monitor, or legal certification
x-fcis-regulatory-maintenance.cadence: monthly and on applicable law/product/deployment changes
x-fcis-regulatory-maintenance.registerAuthority: Per affected deployable product/service; an existing editorial-app register cannot certify the new Go issuer

x-fcis-prerequisite-free.firstOwner: local, one-use setup ticket and WebAuthn registration (not the deployed Golden Key)
x-fcis-prerequisite-free.optionalAdoption: historical issuer, Store, vault, SSH, Host and grants are optional inputs only to explicitly requested adopt-existing
